sql:
SELECT
  vertical,
  merchant_count,
  payment_count,
  gross_captured_eur,
  amount_refunded_eur,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN gross_captured_eur = 0 THEN NULL ELSE amount_refunded_eur / gross_captured_eur * 100 END, 2) AS refund_rate_pct,
  ROUND(avg_refund_rate_pct, 2) AS avg_refund_rate_per_merchant_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    vertical,
    COUNT(*) AS merchant_count,
    SUM(payment_count) AS payment_count,
    SUM(gross_captured_eur) AS gross_captured_eur,
    SUM(amount_refunded_eur) AS amount_refunded_eur,
    AVG(tenant_refund_rate_pct) AS avg_refund_rate_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(t.industry, 'Unknown') AS vertical,
      t.id AS tenant_id,
      COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
      SUM(p.amount / er.rate) AS gross_captured_eur,
      SUM(p.amount_refunded / er.rate) AS amount_refunded_eur,
      CASE WHEN SUM(p.amount / er.rate) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE SUM(p.amount_refunded / er.rate) / SUM(p.amount / er.rate) * 100
      END AS tenant_refund_rate_pct
    FROM payments p
    JOIN tenants t ON t.id = p.tenant_id
    JOIN exchange_rates er
      ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
     AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
     AND er.as_of = DATE(p.captured_at)
    WHERE p.captured_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND p.captured_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND p.status IN ('captured','refunded','partially_refunded')
    GROUP BY COALESCE(t.industry, 'Unknown'), t.id
  ) AS tenant_agg
  GROUP BY vertical
) AS vertical_agg
ORDER BY refund_rate_pct DESC, vertical ASC
note: Vertical is taken from tenants.industry (free-text field, not a fixed enum); tenants with a null industry are grouped under 'Unknown'. Both refund-rate measures and the EUR conversion are computed from captured payments only, using the exchange rate as of each payment's captured_at date.
